QuestInfo.name: Luvar's Request
QuestInfo.0: Listen to #p1040004#'s troubles. Looks like he needs serious help.
QuestInfo.1: #r#o3210800#s#k have stolen #b#p1040004#'s#k staff, and he has no idea how to fight without it. That's pretty weak, but you really should give the guy a break. Eliminate #r#o3210800#s#k and bring back his #b#t4033006##k. Those #r#o3210800#s#k appear all over #b#m101040000##k.
QuestInfo.2: Since you brought back the staff, #p1040004# seems more at ease. But for some reason, his mood has turned quite dark. Did something happen while you were gone?
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: EXP 3,500 Can proceed to the Zombie Lupin's Threat quest

0.0: Those dastardly #o3210800#s have caused me no end of trouble.\r\nIf you want to help, now is the time to start.

yes.0: The thing is, those #r#o3210800#s#k took my staff. They laid a trap for me...banana peels...and when I slipped and fell, they snatched up my staff! Horrible little #r#o3210800#s#k... Hey, stop laughing!
yes.1: Just go and get my staff back from the #r#o3210800#s#k. You'll find tons of #r#o3210800#s#k here in the #b#m101040000##k.

no.0: Did you come out here just to make fun of me, then? I slipped on a banana one time. ONE TIME. It wasn't even that funny!

1.0: Oh, yes. This is my staff. Oh, how I've missed you!

yes.0: I appreciate your help, #h0#. Also, let me apologize for being a little...well, being a jerk. These Lupins have put me in such a foul mood, and I've been quite rude.

item.0: I don't know which #r#o3210800##k took my staff. You just have to eliminate them all until you get to the one that has it. Heh heh heh.
